Consequently unavailable or mismatched intent membership cannot affect classification.

Fresh probes produced 8 expected, 8 observed and 4 inactive entries for an individual Evidence audit, then zero entries in all three fields after scoped preparation marked E3 ACTIVE. The semantic UNKNOWN prevents completion but does not supply the required auditable receipt.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Aggregate active-root expected, observed and checked-inactive obligations into scoped receipts while preserving associations. Assert literal accounting contents for active and mixed scopes and retain incomplete semantic status.

blocking_findings.description: Computed-output execution still lacks deletion-sensitive acceptance coverage. Tests assert operand rejection and generic support without requiring Evidence.digest or TestPlan.authored output obligations. Independently deleting the entire computed loop in memory left all 83 computed operand/nested controls passing per isolated adapter. Both ledgers lose the same obligation because they share the implementation.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add independently specified computed-output values and obligation identities, plus isolated omission, substitution and output-boundary failure controls. Deleting either computation or its output boundary must fail ordinary acceptance tests on direct and retained paths.
